```ts
import { attachConfigurableFreeControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

// Every movement key the default free control hears: WASD, the four arrows,
// Space/PageUp (rise) and ShiftLeft/ShiftRight/PageDown (sink).
const MOVE_KEYS = [
  "KeyW",
  "KeyA",
  "KeyS",
  "KeyD",
  "ArrowUp",
  "ArrowLeft",
  "ArrowRight",
  "ArrowDown",
  "Space",
  "PageUp",
  "ShiftLeft",
  "ShiftRight",
  "PageDown",
] as const;

/**
 * Gives the camera the library's keyboard + mouse fly controls on `canvas`,
 * with every movement key moving 20x as far as the default control while it
 * is held. Mouse look is exactly the library default.
 *
 * The 20x is done through the control's own "fast" option rather than by
 * multiplying camera.speed: the free control stops look inertia once the
 * decayed turn falls below speed * 0.001, so changing speed would also
 * change how far a drag turns the camera once it has come to rest. Leaving
 * speed alone keeps mouse look identical.
 *
 * Returns the library's disposer, which removes all canvas listeners and the
 * control's per-frame step; we add nothing of our own, so nothing is left
 * running.
 */
export function attachBigWorldFly(
  camera: FreeCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
): () => void {
  return attachConfigurableFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene, {
    fastKeys: MOVE_KEYS,
    fastMultiplier: 20,
  });
}
```

```ts
import { attachConfigurableFreeControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

/**
 * All movement keys that attachFreeControl listens for by default
 * (WASD, arrows, Space/PageUp up, Shift/PageDown down).
 * Listing every one of them as "fast" keys makes the whole default set
 * move at fastMultiplier, instead of just a subset.
 */
const BIG_WORLD_MOVE_KEYS = [
  "KeyW",
  "KeyA",
  "KeyS",
  "KeyD",
  "ArrowUp",
  "ArrowLeft",
  "ArrowRight",
  "ArrowDown",
  "Space",
  "PageUp",
  "ShiftLeft",
  "ShiftRight",
  "PageDown",
] as const;

export function attachBigWorldFly(
  camera: FreeCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
): () => void {
  // Attach the library's own free fly control (keyboard + mouse),
  // but with every default movement key marked as "fast" and a fast
  // multiplier of 20, so while a key is held the camera moves 20x as
  // far as it would under the default control.
  //
  // We deliberately do not touch camera.speed: attachFreeControl's look
  // inertia cutoff is speed * 0.001, so multiplying speed would change
  // how far a drag turns the camera once it has come to rest. Leaving
  // speed alone keeps mouse look bit-identical to the default control.
  return attachConfigurableFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene, {
    fastKeys: BIG_WORLD_MOVE_KEYS,
    fastMultiplier: 20,
  });
}
```
